data.gender_notes: janaan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'j-n-n', meaning 'grace' or 'affection'. It is a name full of warmth and tenderness, evoking images of the gentle touch of a mother's love. In Islamic tradition, the name is often associated with the beautiful qualities of God, such as mercy, compassion, and gentleness. The name janaan carries the meaning “Grace, gentleness, affection” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose janaan usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, gentleness, affection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
